'''House Tionc''' was a [[Noble/Legends|Noble]] House on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kilia IV/Legends|Kilia IV]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the female heir to House Tionc was kidnapped by a group of [[Renegades]]. This led to a [[Kilian Rangers/Legends|Kilian Ranger]] recruiting a group of adventurers to help rescue her.
